extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: TextVQA contains 45,336 questions on 28,408 images that require reasoning about text to answer.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by having sighted humans ask questions that require reading and reasoning about text found in images, and providing 10 ground truth answers for each question-image pair.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The source images were taken from the Open Images dataset, specifically selecting categories that are likely to contain text.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Humans were tasked with asking questions about images and providing ground truth answers.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to improve VQA models for real-world assistive applications, specifically to help visually impaired users who frequently need to ask questions about text in their surroundings.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed to be used as a benchmark for training and evaluating VQA models on their ability to read and reason about text in images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Raw text questions are made ML-ready by embedding words using a pre-trained embedding function like GloVe. Image data is preprocessed by extracting grid-based features via average pooling from a pre-trained ResNet-152 and region-based features from a Faster-RCNN model.
